title: Updated post price hike: Great value, so far more skincare than makeup products
text:
I'm 2 months in on this subscription and super pleased. Receiving multiple full size products each month, all of which are products I actually use, is fantastic! Both May and June boxes contained products that were mostly skin care, which is just fine by me.

I am enjoying this box more than I did Birchbox, Ipsy, and the Sephora box. It is $15 instead of $10 but I find the price is acceptable because of the full size products and that each of the products is useful (instead of a throw-away perfume sample like we've all probably received in the other boxes).

-- update 4 months in --
Still absolutely loving this subscription. It is consistently more skin care than makeup and I'm completely good with that. The box always includes at least 1 full size item and I've been enjoying every sample that has come through. So pleased with the value and the breadth of brands - a nice mix of known, trusted mid-high tier brands, drug store brands, and a few new-to-me international brands. Love this subscription!

-- updated post price hike--
Decided to give it a try after the format change (more full sized products) and price hike; received that first box this week and just find that it's not worth it. The box is more make-up heavy, which in my case means a give-away product that I'll never use (matte red lipstick). I also think the vitamin C powder included in the box is such a piece of marketing rubbish, I would be amazed if the company that makes it ever hits sales beyond what the subscription boxes got from them. So heavier on make-up products, with disappointing skincare products. Canceled subscription as this is no longer worth it, no longer recommend.
label: negative
